go--noun.def: An attempt or a turn at doing something.
go--noun.ex: Let me have a go at it.

back--verb.def: To support a person, a plan or an idea.
back--verb.ex: The whole team backed her plan.

take--noun.def: Your own opinion about a subject.
take--noun.ex: What is your take on the new rules?
take--noun.exTr: Yeni kurallar hakkında senin görüşün ne?

more--adv.def: To a greater degree than before or than something else.
more--adv.ex: Try to rest more this week.
more--adv.exTr: Bu hafta daha çok dinlenmeye çalış.

please--verb.def: To make someone feel happy or satisfied.
please--verb.ex: It is hard to please everyone.

even--adj.def: Flat and level, or equal in amount.
even--adj.ex: The two teams have an even score.

talk--noun.def: A conversation, or a short speech given to a group.
talk--noun.ex: She gave a talk about her research.

last--adv.def: Most recently, or at the end of a series.
last--adv.ex: When did you last see him?
last--adv.exTr: Onu en son ne zaman gördün?

last--verb.def: To continue for a period of time.

leave--noun.def: Time away from work that your employer allows.
leave--noun.ex: He is on leave until Monday.

name--verb.def: To give a person or a thing a name.

place--verb.def: To put something carefully in a particular position.
place--verb.ex: Place the box on the shelf.

fine--noun.def: Money you must pay as a punishment.
fine--noun.ex: He paid a fine for parking there.
fine--noun.exTr: Oraya park ettiği için para cezası ödedi.

through--adv.def: From one end or side to the other.
through--adv.ex: Read the letter through before you sign.
through--adv.exTr: İmzalamadan önce mektubu baştan sona oku.

stay--noun.def: A period of time spent in a place as a visitor.

own--verb.def: To have something as your property.

care--verb.def: To feel that something is important to you.
care--verb.ex: I don't care what they say.

room--verb.def: To share a rented room with another person.
room--verb.ex: She roomed with Ayşe at university.

live--adj.def: Broadcast at the same moment it happens.
live--adj.ex: The match is live on channel four.

haven--noun.ex: The garden is a haven for birds.
haven--noun.exTr: Bahçe kuşlar için güvenli bir sığınak.

whole--noun.def: A complete thing containing all of its parts.
whole--noun.ex: These small pieces form a whole.
whole--noun.exTr: Bu küçük parçalar bir bütün oluşturuyor.

while--noun.def: A period of time, usually a short one.

guess--noun.def: An answer you give without being sure.

hope--verb.def: To want something to happen and believe it is possible.
hope--verb.ex: I hope the weather stays dry.

excuse--verb.def: To forgive someone for a small mistake.

second--adv.def: In second position, or as the second point.
second--adv.ex: She finished second in the race.

working--adj.def: Having a job, or operating correctly.

kid--verb.def: To say something untrue as a joke.
kid--verb.ex: Don't worry, I was only kidding.

shut--adj.ex: The shop was shut all weekend.

hit--noun.def: A blow, or something that becomes very successful.
hit--noun.ex: Her new song is a big hit.
hit--noun.exTr: Yeni şarkısı büyük bir başarı yakaladı.

deal--verb.def: To take action about a problem or a subject.

sleep--noun.def: The natural rest in which you are not awake.
sleep--noun.ex: I need a good night's sleep.
sleep--noun.exTr: İyi bir gece uykusuna ihtiyacım var.

least--adv.def: To the smallest degree or amount.
least--adv.ex: This is the least expensive option.

hurt--adj.def: Injured, or feeling upset by something.

fight--verb.def: To use force or effort against someone or something.
fight--verb.exTr: Daha iyi ücretler için mücadele ettiler.

rest--noun.def: A short break from activity, or the part that remains.
rest--noun.ex: Take a rest before you continue.

rest--verb.def: To stop working in order to relax.
rest--verb.ex: The doctor told her to rest.

cut--noun.def: A wound made by something sharp, or a reduction.
cut--noun.ex: He has a small cut on his finger.

able--adj.def: Having the skill or the chance to do something.
able--adj.ex: She was able to finish on time.

trouble--verb.def: To disturb someone or cause them worry.
trouble--verb.ex: May I trouble you for a match?

welcome--adj.ex: The rain was a welcome change.

half--adv.def: Partly, to the extent of one half.

stupid--adj.def: Showing a lack of thought or intelligence.

sometimes--adv.def: On some occasions but not always.

hate--noun.def: A very strong feeling of dislike.
hate--noun.ex: His speech was full of hate.

light--verb.ex: She lit a candle by the window.

clear--verb.def: To remove things from a place so it is empty.
clear--verb.ex: Please clear the table after dinner.

pick--noun.def: The person or thing that someone chooses.

plan--verb.def: To decide in advance how you will do something.
plan--verb.ex: We are planning a trip to Rize.

sort--noun.def: A group of things that are similar in some way.
sort--noun.ex: What sort of music do you like?

promise--verb.def: To tell someone you will certainly do something.
promise--verb.ex: He promised to call me tonight.
promise--verb.exTr: Bu akşam beni arayacağına söz verdi.

book--verb.def: To arrange to have a seat, a room or a ticket.
book--verb.ex: I booked a table for four.

serious--adj.def: Bad enough to worry about, or not joking.

past--adj.ex: She has been ill for the past week.

touch--verb.def: To put your hand on something.

top--adj.def: Highest in position or in rank.
top--adj.ex: He is the top student in class.

control--verb.def: To have the power to decide how something behaves.

human--noun.def: A person, rather than an animal or a machine.

murder--verb.def: To kill a person on purpose and against the law.
murder--verb.ex: He was murdered in his own home.

hang--verb.def: To attach something at the top so it hangs down.
hang--verb.ex: Hang your coat behind the door.

sex--noun.def: The state of being male or female.
sex--noun.ex: The form asks for your age and sex.

lie--noun.def: Something you say that you know is not true.

sign--verb.def: To write your name on a document.
sign--verb.ex: Sign the contract at the bottom.

bet--verb.def: To risk money on the result of an event.
bet--verb.ex: He bet ten lira on the horse.

beat--verb.def: To defeat someone, or to hit repeatedly.
beat--verb.ex: Our team beat them three to one.

secret--adj.ex: They met in a secret place.

date--verb.def: To go out with someone romantically, or to write a date on.
date--verb.ex: They have been dating since spring.

fall--noun.def: A drop to a lower level, or autumn in American English.
fall--noun.ex: There was a sharp fall in prices.

future--adj.def: Happening or existing in the time to come.
future--adj.ex: Save these notes for future use.
future--adj.exTr: Bu notları ileride kullanmak için sakla.

calm--adj.def: Quiet and not excited or worried.
calm--adj.ex: Stay calm and wait for help.

absolutely--adv.def: Completely, or used to agree very strongly.

land--noun.def: The solid part of the earth, or ground someone owns.
land--noun.ex: They bought land near the sea.

wonder--noun.def: A feeling of surprise, or something amazing.

worth--adj.def: Having a particular value, or deserving the effort.
worth--adj.ex: The house is worth a million lira.

dude--noun.def: An informal American word for a man or a friend.
dude--noun.ex: That dude works at the garage.

president--noun.def: The elected leader of a country or an organization.
president--noun.ex: The president gave a short speech.

amazing--adj.def: So good or surprising that you can hardly believe it.
amazing--adj.ex: The view from the top is amazing.

act--verb.def: To behave in a certain way, or to perform a part.
act--verb.ex: He acted like nothing had happened.

weird--adj.def: Strange in a way that is hard to explain.
weird--adj.ex: I heard a weird noise upstairs.
weird--adj.exTr: Üst katta tuhaf bir ses duydum.
